purpose: Teach: 非課税/管区/掌握/発現/短調/寛大/トップクラス/発効

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、奨学金の非課税扱いも理解しろ
lines.en: Ren — understand the tax-exempt status of scholarships.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Matter-of-fact opening, slight emphasis on 「Ren」 to signal attention. Steady authority without coldness. The tone of someone who expects understanding and compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究管区の制度を学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll study the scholarship system thoroughly.
lines.style: Respectful and intent. Nod-like quality at the start. Quiet determination underneath. Speaking not to perform obedience but to show genuine commitment to the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究分野の掌握をしっかりせよ
lines.en: Ren — get a firm grasp on your research field.
lines.style: Slightly firmer than before. Lean forward in the voice. Not impatient, but a nudge toward urgency. The mentor who knows where the weak points are and is naming them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説の発現を実験で確かめます
lines.en: Yes. I'll test my hypotheses experimentally and confirm the results.
lines.style: Focused and careful. Slight tension in the shoulders of the voice — trying to prove competence. Clear articulation, no rushing. The earnestness of someone taking the feedback seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文構成も時に短調的に整えろ
lines.en: Ren — structure your paper with clarity and restraint.
lines.style: Calm, instructional. Direct gaze in the voice. Not harsh, but precise — the quality of feedback that comes from experience. Slight pause before the instruction lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。査読者の寛大な指摘に感謝します
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the reviewers' generous feedback.
lines.style: Measured gratitude. Quiet professionalism in the delivery. Not overeager, but sincere — acknowledging the value without fawning. Even cadence, slight warmth at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、トップクラスの学術誌を目指せ
lines.en: Ren — aim for top-tier academic journals.
lines.style: Encouraging underneath the directness. Slight lift on 「aim」 — not a command but an invitation upward. The mentor who believes the student is capable of reaching higher.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新ガイドラインの発効日に対応します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to meet the new guidelines' effective date.
lines.style: Dutiful and closing. Slight finality in the tone — wrapping up the mentorship moment. Respectful, with a note of quiet determination. The last word slightly softer, releasing tension.
